+    return out

+

+    """Move the fingertip-centre while keeping the selected downward grasp."""
+    global step_no
+    step_no += 1
+    row = np.array([[x, y, z, *orientation, float(gripper)]], dtype=np.float32)
+    result = r.submit("ee_pose", row, video="mp4", note=tag)
+    out = save_result(tag, result)

+    return result

+    joints = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"][:7], dtype=np.float32)
+    rows = max(1, int(round(seconds / 0.2)))
+    actions = np.tile(np.r_[joints, float(command)], (rows, 1))
+    result = r.submit("joint_position", actions, dt=0.2, video="mp4", note=tag)
